method.build: Isolated production-mode SSG snapshots of the current working tree; city statistics use the same fixture in both snapshots.
method.serving: Compressed local HTTPS/HTTP2 assets mapped to wareongo.com inside each fresh audit browser.
method.throttling: Default simulated mobile Slow 4G, 4x CPU, 412x823 viewport, DPR 1.75.
method.sequence: Three alternating before/after pairs for the initial optimization, followed by three final runs after visual-preservation adjustments; no concurrent builds or browser tests.
method.analytics: Production GA4 script downloaded and executed; analytics collection requests blocked.
method.baseline: First WebP pass before the JavaScript/hydration optimizations. Includes logo variants subsequently reverted to preserve exact logo rendering. Earlier 85-point HTTP/1.1 results are not this baseline.
method.productionStatus: Local lab results; no deployment or live PageSpeed measurement.

changes: Load contact and navigation dialogs on first use, retaining their state after closing.
Load inventory route loaders and static-path discovery on demand instead of in the shared entry bundle.
Use content already validated by the build; keep ad-page validation and migration in build/CMS preview code.
Yield a frame before ad-page hydration so the existing static HTML can paint.
Serve responsive WebP warehouse photos with the original image URLs available as fallbacks.

validation.browser: Passed at 390/768/1440px: SSG before JS, stable headline hydration, responsive image/fallback/resize recovery, filters, carousel and mocked enquiries. Shared homepage/Bangalore navigation and dialogs passed on mobile and desktop, including delayed chunks, search, focus restoration, preserved form drafts and exactly one GA4 lead event.
validation.staticOutput: Main content, link labels/destinations and title match the baseline. Initial cards, tables, FAQ answers, form markup and statistics remain in SSG HTML.
validation.enquiry: POST /enquiries only on submission; browser verification mocked the response.
validation.clientNavigation: Generated static loader manifest and route JSON.

visualPreservation.reference: Production SSG snapshot from before all performance changes, with identical approved page content and fixture statistics.
visualPreservation.interactiveStates: FAQ toggle, listing filter, expanded map preview, contact dialog and navigation dialog match the original geometry and design styles.
visualPreservation.screenshots: Text-only sections match pixel-for-pixel. Photo pixels differ because of responsive resizing/WebP compression; image identity, proportions, object-fit, object-position and frame geometry are preserved. Photo rendering was also inspected at 2x pixel density on mobile and desktop.
visualPreservation.preservedSource: Landing-page CSS, trusted-logo component and logo source manifest are byte-identical to the original.
visualPreservation.adjustments: Removed content-visibility/estimated section heights and restored original logo source selection to eliminate changed initial page heights and subpixel logo sizing.
